The '''''Piece of Donkey''''' hair is required to make the [[Pagan amulet of spirit summoning]] at the [[Church workbench]] with 1 [[Intestine]] and 1 [[Beeswax]]. It is obtained from a cutscene with [[Donkey]].

It is used to make the [[Pagan amulet of spirit summoning]]. 

==Notes==

*In patch 1.400, Donkey gives [[Piece of donkey hair]] after receiving [[Revolutionary message]] 2.
